description: This file contains extension methods for configuring streaming capabilities on an Orleans client builder, including support for in-memory and persistent stream providers.

classes.name: ClientBuilderStreamingExtensions
classes.description: A static class providing extension methods to enhance Orleans IClientBuilder with streaming support.

methods.name: AddStreaming
methods.description: Enables streaming support on the Orleans client by configuring services to add client streaming.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams
methods.description: Adds an in-memory stream provider with default serializer to the client builder.

methods.name: AddMemoryStreams<TSerializer>
methods.description: Adds an in-memory stream provider with a specified serializer to the client builder, with optional configuration.

methods.name: AddPersistentStreams
methods.description: Adds a persistent stream provider with a specified adapter factory and configuration.
